page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a general-purpose, memory-optimized virtual machine featuring high-density NVMe storage. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor operating at 2.3 GHz. The instance is allocated 24 dedicated vCPUs spanning 12 physical cores with 2 threads per core, backed by 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 504 MB L3 cache. It incorporates 186.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled directly via 4 local NVMe SSDs totaling 1,608 GB of capacity, with no discrete GPUs included.

Benchmark results highlight strong single-thread and memory-intensive processing characteristics. In single-core evaluations, the server achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core tests (2,321.0), single-threaded gzip compression (36.68 GB/sec), and single-threaded bzip3 decompression (15.42 GB/sec). Multi-core synthetic tests show strong performance with a Geekbench multi-core score of 16,159.0 and average ratings across stress-ng (27,231.53) and PassMark CPU metrics (41,495.56). Uncached memory bandwidth reaches 153.52 GB/sec for reads and 56.59 GB/sec for writes.

For specialized processing, the processor integrates Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instruction sets. This hardware feature set is reflected in small-model language inference benchmarks, where the instance scores in the top tier for text generation (394.37 tokens/sec on a 135M model) and strong for prompt processing (2,400.47 tokens/sec). Performance normalizes into the middle tier on larger models, recording 151.39 prompt tokens/sec and 20.25 generation tokens/sec on 7B models.

From a resource and efficiency standpoint, the c4-highmem-24-lssd delivers a high ratio of memory and high-speed local disk capacity per compute core. The bundled 1,608 GB NVMe configuration avoids network-attached storage latency for scratch and cache data. The configuration is particularly suited for high-throughput relational and in-memory databases, data analytics, ETL processing pipelines, and caching layers like Redis.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance equipped with an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. It delivers 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores, accompanied by 186.0 GB of RAM (7.75 GB per core) and 1,608 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage across 4 drives, with zero discrete GPUs. The instance demonstrates top-tier single-core Geekbench performance (2,321.0) and top-tier compression execution, paired with solid multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities (153.52 GB/sec large-block read). Supported by hardware vector and matrix extensions including AMX and AVX-512, it shows strong lightweight LLM inference speeds. Its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and high-speed local storage make it well matched for in-memory databases, Redis deployments, data processing pipelines, and low-latency storage workloads.
